questions.question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get each year?
questions.answer: Full‑time employees receive 24 days of paid time off each calendar year【1】.

questions.question: How many unused PTO days can I carry over, and when do they expire?
questions.answer: You can carry over up to 5 unused PTO days into the next calendar year, and any carried‑over days expire on 31 March [1].

questions.question: How long is parental leave for a secondary caregiver?
questions.answer: Secondary caregivers receive eight weeks of fully paid parental leave [1].

questions.question: What notice period applies to a people manager after probation?
questions.answer: After completing the 90‑day probation, a people manager’s notice period is 60 days [1].

questions.question: How many days a week do hybrid employees need to be in the office, and which day is the company-wide office day?
questions.answer: Hybrid employees are expected to be in a Lumen office at least three days per week, and Tuesday is the company‑wide in‑office day. [1]

questions.question: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
questions.answer: A doctor's note is required only when an employee’s sick‑leave absence exceeds three consecutive working days【1】.

questions.question: How long can I work from another country without extra approval?
questions.answer: Employees may work from another country for up to 20 working days per calendar year without needing additional approval; longer periods require People Operations approval【1】.

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night in London?
questions.answer: The hotel limit in London is $300 per night before taxes. [1]

questions.question: What is the daily meal per diem for international travel?
questions.answer: The daily meal per diem for international travel is $90 per day【1】.

questions.question: Above what amount do I need a receipt for an expense?
questions.answer: A receipt is required for every expense that exceeds $25 [1].

questions.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for using my own car?
questions.answer: The mileage reimbursement rate for using a personal car for business travel is $0.67 per mile【1】.

questions.question: Which tool do I use to submit expenses and what is the deadline?
questions.answer: You submit expenses through the company’s expense tool, Ledgerly, and you must do so within 30 days of the expense date【1】.

questions.question: Can I book business class for a 12-hour flight?
questions.answer: Yes, a 12‑hour flight qualifies for business‑class booking, but it requires prior approval from a Vice President. [1]

questions.question: Is travel insurance reimbursable?
questions.answer: No, travel insurance is not reimbursable under the policy. [1]

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long【1】.

questions.question: What second factor must administrators use?
questions.answer: Administrators must use a hardware security key as their second factor for multi‑factor authentication. [1]

questions.question: Can I paste customer farm-field maps into a public chatbot?
questions.answer: No. Customer farm‑field maps are classified as Restricted data and must never be pasted into third‑party AI tools or public chatbots. [1]

questions.question: How quickly must access be revoked when someone leaves the company?
questions.answer: Access must be revoked within 4 hours of the employee’s last working hour【1】.

questions.question: How do I report a phishing email and how fast?
questions.answer: Report the suspected phishing email using the “Report phishing” button in the mail client or by posting it in the #sec-report channel, and do so within 1 hour of receipt [1].

questions.question: How fast must the on-call engineer acknowledge a SEV1 page?
questions.answer: The on‑call engineer must acknowledge a SEV1 page within 5 minutes【1】.

questions.question: Within how many days must a postmortem be published after a SEV2?
questions.answer: A postmortem for a SEV2 incident must be published within 5 business days of the incident’s resolution【1】.

questions.question: Who is allowed to issue a fleet-wide return-to-home command?
questions.answer: Only the Incident Commander (IC) or the Head of Flight Operations may issue a fleet‑wide return‑to‑home command. [1]

questions.question: How soon must customers be notified after a confirmed data breach?
questions.answer: Customers must be notified within 72 hours of the breach being confirmed [1].

questions.question: What is the Falcon X2's flight time with a full payload?
questions.answer: The Falcon X2 can fly for 28 minutes when carrying its maximum payload. [1]

questions.question: How accurate is the Falcon X2's RTK GPS?
questions.answer: The Falcon X2’s RTK GPS provides horizontal positioning accuracy of ±2 cm【1】.

questions.question: How long does it take to charge a Falcon X2 battery to 90%?
questions.answer: It takes 18 minutes to charge a Falcon X2 battery from 0 % to 90 % using the Lumen Rapid Charger【1】.

questions.question: What does the Falcon X2 warranty cover for batteries?
questions.answer: The warranty covers batteries for 12 months or for 600 charge cycles, whichever occurs first【1】.

questions.question: How many hectares per hour can the Falcon X2 spray?
questions.answer: The Falcon X2 can treat up to **22 hectares per hour** in typical field conditions【1】.

questions.question: What is the restocking fee for returning an opened drone?
questions.answer: The restocking fee for returning an opened drone is 15% of the purchase price【1】.

questions.question: What response time do Enterprise customers get from support?
questions.answer: Enterprise customers receive a guaranteed first response from support within 4 hours, 24 hours a day, every day of the year【1】.

questions.question: How much does a spare battery cost?
questions.answer: A spare battery costs $1,150 each【1】.

questions.question: How much is the annual learning budget?
questions.answer: The annual learning budget is $2,000 per calendar year for each employee【1】.

questions.question: What is the 401(k) match and when does it vest?
questions.answer: Lumen matches 100 % of an employee’s 401(k) contributions up to 4 % of base salary, and those matching contributions vest immediately【1】.

questions.question: When is open enrollment for 2027 benefits?
questions.answer: Open enrollment for the 2027 benefits runs from 2 November to 20 November 2026【1】.

questions.question: I am flying 7 hours to London for a conference. Which flight class can I book and what is my hotel limit?
Compared with the Falcon X1, how much longer does the Falcon X2 fly when empty, and what is its empty flight time?
questions.answer: The Falcon X2 flies 9 minutes longer when empty than the Falcon X1, and its empty flight time is 42 minutes【1】【2】

questions.question: As a remote employee, what home-office money do I get in my first year in total, including 12 months of internet allowance?
questions.answer: A remote employee receives a one‑time home‑office stipend of $600 and an internet allowance of $50 each month; over 12 months the internet allowance totals $50 × 12 = $600, so the first‑year total is $600 + $600 = $1,200【1】.

questions.question: As the non-birthing parent, how much paid time can I take after my baby arrives?
questions.answer: As a secondary (non‑birthing) caregiver you are entitled to 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave after the baby arrives【1】.

questions.question: What's the most I can spend on a room per night when visiting Zurich?
questions.answer: The maximum hotel allowance for a night in Zurich is $300 per night before taxes【1】.

questions.question: If my work computer gets stolen, how soon do I have to tell someone?
questions.answer: You must report a stolen work computer to IT within 24 hours of the loss【1】.

questions.question: How long does the drone stay airborne when it's carrying as much as it can?
questions.answer: The Falcon X2 can stay airborne for 28 minutes when carrying its maximum payload of 10 kg【2】.

questions.question: I'm an engineer without reports and I want to quit. How much warning do I have to give?
How much do I get each month toward the gym?
questions.answer: You receive a $75 per‑month wellness allowance that can be applied to gym memberships, fitness classes, or meditation apps. [1]
